name: Iridic-Zij
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a binary sunset, and everything the light never reaches.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Whoever controls water controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
